# Santa Catarina Front-Row Suite, Porto

> A 56 m2 vacation rental apartment directly on Rua de Santa Catarina, the pedestrian shopping street in central Porto, Portugal. Licensed Alojamento Local 165999/AL.

## Facts
- Address: Rua de Santa Catarina 392, 2 Frt Esq, Porto, Portugal
- Maximum occupancy: 2 guests
- Sleeping arrangements: 1 double bed and 1 sofa bed; two guests can sleep separately
- Bathroom: 1 bathroom with shower
- Size: 56 m2, second floor with lift
- Three tall French windows facing Rua de Santa Catarina; dedicated sleeping area
- Amenities: air conditioning, Wi-Fi, dedicated workspace, TV, washer and dryer, full kitchen (oven, stove, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, kettle)
- Check-in from 16:00, check-out until 11:00

## Booking
Bookings and payments only via Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1455066495407495959

## Location notes
Pedestrian street with shops and cafes. Short walk to Bolhao Market, Capela das Almas (blue tiled chapel) and Bolhao metro station.
